title: Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan Servicing Timetable: Offer, Notice, Funding and Cancellation Periods
content:
Loan operations keep one timetable for the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan. Each period runs from a named business event and is counted either in calendar days or in business days, as shown; the figures are identical in all six tiers, Paystride Payroll Loan 500 through Paystride Payroll Loan 5000.

| Period or setting | Runs from | Counted in | Figure in every tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| An approved offer stays open for acceptance | the approval of the offer | calendar days | 14 |
| The adverse action notice is sent within | a decline | calendar days | 30 |
| The loan is funded within | acceptance | business days | 1 |
| The first installment may not fall before | funding | calendar days | 7 |
| The borrower may cancel by returning the principal without interest or fee within | funding | business days | 3 |

| Setting | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Where proceeds may be sent | the borrower's Paystride card, or a bank account |
| A revocable payroll deduction authorization must be signed | Yes |

### Calendar days and business days

The offer period, the notice period and the first-installment period count calendar days. The funding period and the cancellation period count business days.

### Hypothetical readings

- An offer approved 9 calendar days ago is within its 14-day open period; one approved 20 calendar days ago is past it.
- A loan funded 2 business days ago is within the 3-business-day cancellation period; one funded 6 business days ago is not.
- Funding on a hypothetical day 0: a payday on day 4 is earlier than 7 calendar days after funding, a payday on day 7 is 7 calendar days after funding, and a payday on day 11 is later.
